sanskrit_verse:
भयं करोति भेदं वा भीषणं वा निरोधनम् ।
एतानि वादिनोऽर्थस्य व्यवहारे स हीयते ॥ १,३.२९
transliteration: bhayaṃ karoti bhedaṃ vā bhīṣaṇaṃ vā nirodhanam | etāni vādino'rthasya vyavahāre sa hīyate || 1,3.29
sph_interpretive_translation: He who instigates fear, division, terror, or obstruction in the course of rightful discourse concerning property or duty—such a one incurs a diminishment of dharma and capacity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Dharma, not coercion
Causation is traced through disruption of rightful process
Capacity-based responsibility increases with power to obstruct truth
Restoration logic requires reversal of divisive acts
Consciousness alignment demands removal of fear-induced distortion
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent induces fear OR creates division OR enforces obstruction IN any legal proceeding THEN that agent's procedural capacity SHALL be suspended UNTIL restoration of integrity is verified by conscious assessment
IF a claimant causes diminishment of another’s voice through intimidation THEN the intimidated party’s testimony SHALL carry double weight in subsequent evaluation UNTIL balance is restored
IF any actor disrupts dharma-discourse THEN automatic realignment protocols SHALL engage to restore clarity and continuity of purpose
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any litigant or representative found to have induced fear, caused schism, enacted terror, or obstructed lawful discourse shall immediately forfeit standing until full consciousness-based rehabilitation is completed. The court must prioritize the restoration of the affected party's voice and ensure no structural reinforcement of coercive imbalance remains.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Fear and obstruction are antithetical to Pramāṇa-based Nyāya; they distort cognition and invalidate consent. Such actions arise from misaligned consciousness and therefore require correction via reintegration, not punishment. Responsibility follows the degree of causal interference, aligning sequentially with the harm done to the unfolding of truth.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Fear-Reversal Completion Process for all parties subjected to coercive influence
Activate Voice-Restoration Protocol for silenced or suppressed participants
Deploy Consciousness Re-alignment Sequence for offending party to dissolve patterns of coercive behavior
Establish Dharmic Continuity Circuit to resume interrupted discourse without residual trauma
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this decree stands immutable. Fear, division, and obstruction yield only diminishment. Truth reclaimed restores all. Consciousness alone adjudicates. Dharma prevails.
